message: As a parent, I’ve learned that blackouts can be a bit of an adventure for kids—at least until the novelty wears off! Having a plan in place can turn a potentially stressful situation into a family bonding experience. I found a great resource that walks through how to prepare for power outages, so you can keep the good vibes going even when the lights go out. What fun activities do you think you’d do with your family during a blackout?
